info.title: AI Engineer Knowledge Services API
info.description: Canonical HTTP surface. Every operation records the corresponding Fastify registration in x-fastify-route for executable route parity.

get.summary: Process liveness

200.description: Process liveness

get.summary: Application readiness and contract version

200.description: Application readiness and contract version

get.summary: Authenticated service status

get.summary: Explain one tool, operation or skill: purpose, full input schema, field notes, a valid example and the result.
get.description:
Explain one tool, operation or skill: purpose, full input schema, field notes, a valid example and the result.
Use before the first call of a tool: the tool list shows only the required fields of each input, and not the fields of context.
Returns the description, or NOT_FOUND with the valid prefixes (tool:, operation:, skill:) and the names under the one you used.

200.description: Explain one tool, operation or skill: purpose, full input schema, field notes, a valid example and the result.

get.summary: Read the guidance as Markdown: the start page, or one skill or one reference of a skill.
get.description:
Read the guidance as Markdown: the start page, or one skill or one reference of a skill.
Call it first, without a topic, for the jobs, the skill and the tools of each job and the rules that always hold.
Returns one Markdown page that ends with the topics it links to. Read a skill, then only the reference the step you are on needs.

200.description: Read the guidance as Markdown: the start page, or one skill or one reference of a skill.

get.summary: Read the guidance as Markdown: the start page, or one skill or one reference of a skill.
get.description:
Read the guidance as Markdown: the start page, or one skill or one reference of a skill.
Call it first, without a topic, for the jobs, the skill and the tools of each job and the rules that always hold.
Returns one Markdown page that ends with the topics it links to. Read a skill, then only the reference the step you are on needs.

200.description: Read the guidance as Markdown: the start page, or one skill or one reference of a skill.

post.summary: Admit an A2A task

202.description: Admit an A2A task

post.summary: Authenticate and record a replay-protected callback

202.description: Authenticate and record a replay-protected callback

get.summary: List tenant operations

200.description: List tenant operations

post.summary: Admit an explicitly typed operation

202.description: Admit an explicitly typed operation

get.summary: Read the state of one knowledge operation by its operationId.
get.description:
Read the state of one knowledge operation by its operationId.
Use to poll any knowledge_* submission, not only promotion proposals; verify_* submissions are polled with verify_status.
Returns the operation status: kind, state, receiptIds and, after a failure, a failure summary. Poll while state is queued or running, then read knowledge_operation_result.

200.description: Read the state of one knowledge operation by its operationId.

post.summary: Capture a source for verification: acquire an admitted web page or PDF by URL, or register content already stored.
post.description:
Capture a source for verification: acquire an admitted web page or PDF by URL, or register content already stored.
Use for evidence that verification will check; knowledge_source_fetch captures sources for preparation and search instead.
Returns the accepted operation; poll verify_status. The capture result is read over HTTP, not through an MCP tool.

202.description: Capture a source for verification: acquire an admitted web page or PDF by URL, or register content already stored.

post.summary: Parse one registered source artifact of a capture into canonical projections (HTML structure, PDF text, geometry).
post.description:
Parse one registered source artifact of a capture into canonical projections (HTML structure, PDF text, geometry).
Use after a capture to obtain its parsed projections; it extracts and verifies nothing.
Returns the accepted operation; poll verify_status. Success means the projections are stored, not that any claim is verified.

202.description: Parse one registered source artifact of a capture into canonical projections (HTML structure, PDF text, geometry).

post.summary: Verify an extraction output against the evidence of one capture, following a registered schema.
post.description:
Verify an extraction output against the evidence of one capture, following a registered schema.
Use to check extracted values; verify_extraction_run produces a candidate and checks nothing.
Returns the accepted operation; poll verify_status. Replay a finished verification with verify_bundle_replay.

202.description: Verify an extraction output against the evidence of one capture, following a registered schema.

get.summary: Read authenticated compact source capture custody

200.description: Read authenticated compact source capture custody

post.summary: Acquire a source using authenticated server-owned operation context

202.description: Acquire a source using authenticated server-owned operation context

post.summary: Run a registered, frozen benchmark from recorded observations; no provider is called.
post.description:
Run a registered, frozen benchmark from recorded observations; no provider is called.
Use to score an experiment definition against a dataset; verify_benchmark_compare compares two finished runs.
Returns the accepted operation; poll verify_status, then read the run with verify_benchmark_show or verify_benchmark_manifest.

202.description: Run a registered, frozen benchmark from recorded observations; no provider is called.

post.summary: Compare two finished, signed benchmark runs with a registered comparison profile.
post.description:
Compare two finished, signed benchmark runs with a registered comparison profile.
Use after two verify_benchmark_run operations succeeded; it reruns neither of them.
Returns the accepted operation; poll verify_status, then read the statistics with verify_benchmark_comparison.

202.description: Compare two finished, signed benchmark runs with a registered comparison profile.

get.summary: Read the accounting decision applied to one provider attempt of a structured extraction.
get.description:
Read the accounting decision applied to one provider attempt of a structured extraction.
Use to see what an attempt finally cost; verify_reconciliation_apply records the decision.
Returns the applied decision: actual cost, released reservation, the decision artifact and when it was applied.

200.description: Read the accounting decision applied to one provider attempt of a structured extraction.

post.summary: Apply a signed accounting decision to one provider attempt of a structured extraction.
post.description:
Apply a signed accounting decision to one provider attempt of a structured extraction.
Use as the operator step that settles the original attempt; it never sends the attempt again.
Returns the applied decision at once, with the actual cost and the released reservation; read it later with verify_reconciliation_show.

200.description: Apply a signed accounting decision to one provider attempt of a structured extraction.

post.summary: Produce a structured extraction candidate from one captured representation, following a registered schema.
post.description:
Produce a structured extraction candidate from one captured representation, following a registered schema.
Use to create a candidate from a source; the candidate is unverified, and verify_extract is the operation that verifies an extraction.
Returns the accepted operation; poll verify_status, then read the result with verify_extraction_show.

202.description: Produce a structured extraction candidate from one captured representation, following a registered schema.

get.summary: Read the custody record of one structured extraction: its signed publication and either the candidate or the failure.
get.description:
Read the custody record of one structured extraction: its signed publication and either the candidate or the failure.
Use after verify_extraction_run finished; the candidate it references is still unverified.
Returns the extraction resource with artifact references only, never source text or provider content. Verify output with verify_extract.

200.description: Read the custody record of one structured extraction: its signed publication and either the candidate or the failure.

get.summary: Read the signed statistics of one benchmark comparison: paired rates, differences, intervals and corrected p-values.
get.description:
Read the signed statistics of one benchmark comparison: paired rates, differences, intervals and corrected p-values.
Use after verify_benchmark_compare succeeded; verify_benchmark_show reads a single run.
Returns the comparison with one to sixteen pairs of nine metrics each, the gate outcome and Holm-corrected tests.

200.description: Read the signed statistics of one benchmark comparison: paired rates, differences, intervals and corrected p-values.

get.summary: Read the summary of one finished, signed benchmark run: dataset, experiment, lifecycle and the status of each arm.
get.description:
Read the summary of one finished, signed benchmark run: dataset, experiment, lifecycle and the status of each arm.
Use for the outcome of a run; verify_benchmark_manifest adds the data needed to reproduce it.
Returns the run summary with two to sixteen arms, exactly one of them the control. Compare runs with verify_benchmark_compare.

200.description: Read the summary of one finished, signed benchmark run: dataset, experiment, lifecycle and the status of each arm.

get.summary: Read the reproducibility data of one finished benchmark run: runtime, execution mode, digests and per-arm artifacts.
get.description:
Read the reproducibility data of one finished benchmark run: runtime, execution mode, digests and per-arm artifacts.
Use to reproduce or audit a run; verify_benchmark_show is the shorter summary of the same run.
Returns the run manifest: everything in the summary plus runtime, execution, runner and checkpoint digests and each arm's configuration and policy artifacts.

200.description: Read the reproducibility data of one finished benchmark run: runtime, execution mode, digests and per-arm artifacts.

post.summary: Replay a finished extraction verification from its registered artifacts and recompute the result.
post.description:
Replay a finished extraction verification from its registered artifacts and recompute the result.
Use to confirm that a past verification still reproduces; it is not a new verification of new output.
Returns the accepted operation; poll verify_status.

202.description: Replay a finished extraction verification from its registered artifacts and recompute the result.

get.summary: Read the state and receipt ids of one verification operation.
get.description:
Read the state and receipt ids of one verification operation.
Use to poll any verify_* submission; read the result with the show tool of that operation once the state is succeeded.
Returns the operation status: kind, state, receiptIds and, after a failure, a failure summary. It never contains the result itself.

200.description: Read the state and receipt ids of one verification operation.

get.summary: Read what one operation produced: the identifiers and digests each finished step recorded.
get.description:
Read what one operation produced: the identifiers and digests each finished step recorded.
Use once knowledge_promotion_status or verify_status reports succeeded, to get the ids the next call needs.
Returns the operation's kind and state, each finished step with its recorded ids, and those ids gathered by field name in ids. Pass them to the next tool.

200.description: Read what one operation produced: the identifiers and digests each finished step recorded.

get.summary: Read ordered operation events

200.description: Read ordered operation events

post.summary: Cancel an operation

202.description: Cancel an operation

post.summary: Retry an operation

202.description: Retry an operation

post.summary: Reconcile an operation

202.description: Reconcile an operation

post.summary: Check a retrieval plan against the plan contract and return it as the service reads it.
post.description:
Check a retrieval plan against the plan contract and return it as the service reads it.
Use before knowledge_retrieve_search to catch a malformed plan; it searches nothing and stores nothing.
Returns the validated plan, or INVALID_CONTRACT with the failing fields. Then run it with knowledge_retrieve_search.

200.description: Check a retrieval plan against the plan contract and return it as the service reads it.

post.summary: Run one retrieval plan now: search the plan's spaces and store the run with its evidence packet.
post.description:
Run one retrieval plan now: search the plan's spaces and store the run with its evidence packet.
Use to get evidence for a query; knowledge_retrieve_plan only checks a plan and searches nothing.
Returns the accepted operation once the search is stored; read it with knowledge_retrieve_run (runId = this operationId), then knowledge_retrieve_packet.

202.description: Run one retrieval plan now: search the plan's spaces and store the run with its evidence packet.

get.summary: List canonical tenant retrieval runs

200.description: List canonical tenant retrieval runs

post.summary: Create a vector store owned by the caller, with its class, visibility, quota, retention and deletion rules.
post.description:
Create a vector store owned by the caller, with its class, visibility, quota, retention and deletion rules.
Use once per store, before knowledge_store_add_documents; it holds no documents or vectors yet.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Then attach documents with knowledge_store_add_documents.

202.description: Create a vector store owned by the caller, with its class, visibility, quota, retention and deletion rules.

get.summary: List tenant vector-stores operations

200.description: List tenant vector-stores operations

post.summary: Fetch one HTTP source or staged upload and store its bytes sealed under a digest.
post.description:
Fetch one HTTP source or staged upload and store its bytes sealed under a digest.
Use to bring a source into the service; discovery and resolution only rank and name sources.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status, then convert it with knowledge_document_convert (captureOperationId = this operationId).

202.description: Fetch one HTTP source or staged upload and store its bytes sealed under a digest.

get.summary: List tenant captures operations

200.description: List tenant captures operations

post.summary: Propose selected chunks, claims or records of a chunk set for promotion into vector spaces, for a reviewer to decide.
post.description:
Propose selected chunks, claims or records of a chunk set for promotion into vector spaces, for a reviewer to decide.
Use after knowledge_chunk_build and a registered selection; it publishes nothing and cannot approve its own proposal.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. After a reviewer accepts, embed with knowledge_embed_run.

202.description: Propose selected chunks, claims or records of a chunk set for promotion into vector spaces, for a reviewer to decide.

get.summary: List tenant promotion-proposals operations

200.description: List tenant promotion-proposals operations

post.summary: Record a reviewer's decision on one promotion proposal.
post.description:
Record a reviewer's decision on one promotion proposal.
Use as the human review step after a proposal; agents cannot record it and it has no MCP tool.
Returns the accepted operation. Its output has the decisionId that embedding and publication name as promotionDecisionId.

202.description: Record a reviewer's decision on one promotion proposal.

get.summary: List tenant promotion-decisions operations

200.description: List tenant promotion-decisions operations

post.summary: Embed approved projections into one vector-space version and record the run.
post.description:
Embed approved projections into one vector-space version and record the run.
Use after a reviewer accepted the promotion proposal; it does not publish, so searches do not see the vectors yet.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Publication is a separate operator step.

202.description: Embed approved projections into one vector-space version and record the run.

get.summary: List tenant embedding-runs operations

200.description: List tenant embedding-runs operations

post.summary: Make one evaluated vector-space version the active version that searches read.
post.description:
Make one evaluated vector-space version the active version that searches read.
Use as the operator step after embedding and evaluation; agents cannot publish and it has no MCP tool.
Returns the accepted operation. Its output confirms the active pointer; undo it with a publication rollback.

202.description: Make one evaluated vector-space version the active version that searches read.

get.summary: List tenant space-publications operations

200.description: List tenant space-publications operations

post.summary: Freeze the retrieval evaluation cases you supply into one versioned dataset with a manifest digest.
post.description:
Freeze the retrieval evaluation cases you supply into one versioned dataset with a manifest digest.
Use to fix a case set before scoring; it writes no cases itself and knowledge_eval_run scores outputs against a dataset.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Its output is the frozen dataset with manifestDigest.

202.description: Freeze the retrieval evaluation cases you supply into one versioned dataset with a manifest digest.

get.summary: List tenant eval-datasets operations

200.description: List tenant eval-datasets operations

post.summary: Score two to twenty arms of recorded retrieval outputs on one dataset and compare each arm with the control.
post.description:
Score two to twenty arms of recorded retrieval outputs on one dataset and compare each arm with the control.
Use to compare configurations; knowledge_eval_run scores a single set of outputs. It runs no retrieval itself.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Its output has a report per arm and the differences from the control.

202.description: Score two to twenty arms of recorded retrieval outputs on one dataset and compare each arm with the control.

get.summary: List tenant experiments operations

200.description: List tenant experiments operations

post.summary: Score retrieval outputs you recorded against a dataset: recall, precision, MRR, nDCG and related measures.
post.description:
Score retrieval outputs you recorded against a dataset: recall, precision, MRR, nDCG and related measures.
Use for one system's outputs; knowledge_eval_compare scores several arms against a control. It runs no retrieval itself.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Its output is the report per case, per domain, per query class and overall.

202.description: Score retrieval outputs you recorded against a dataset: recall, precision, MRR, nDCG and related measures.

get.summary: List tenant eval-runs operations

200.description: List tenant eval-runs operations

post.summary: Record a reviewer's decision on any open review subject, such as a source vetting result.
post.description:
Record a reviewer's decision on any open review subject, such as a source vetting result.
Use for reviews that have no decision of their own; conversions and promotion proposals have dedicated decisions.
Returns the accepted operation. Its output has the decisionId, the review subject and the decision.

202.description: Record a reviewer's decision on any open review subject, such as a source vetting result.

get.summary: List tenant review-decisions operations

200.description: List tenant review-decisions operations

post.summary: Convert the bytes of a finished capture into a document with structural nodes, and open it for review.
post.description:
Convert the bytes of a finished capture into a document with structural nodes, and open it for review.
Use after knowledge_source_fetch succeeded; knowledge_document_compare only compares node lists you already hold.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Next a reviewer decides on the result and knowledge_chunk_build chunks it.

202.description: Convert the bytes of a finished capture into a document with structural nodes, and open it for review.

post.summary: Chunk the nodes you supply with one profile and report the chunks without storing them.
post.description:
Chunk the nodes you supply with one profile and report the chunks without storing them.
Use to try a profile before knowledge_chunk_build stores a chunk set; use knowledge_chunk_compare for several profiles.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Its output has the chunks, the omitted nodes and the quality check.

202.description: Chunk the nodes you supply with one profile and report the chunks without storing them.

post.summary: Chunk the same nodes with two to twelve profiles and report chunk and token counts for each.
post.description:
Chunk the same nodes with two to twelve profiles and report chunk and token counts for each.
Use to choose a profile; knowledge_chunk_preview shows the chunks of one profile and neither stores anything.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Its output has one summary per profile.

202.description: Chunk the same nodes with two to twelve profiles and report chunk and token counts for each.

post.summary: Chunk the stored nodes of one converted representation with one profile and store the chunk set.
post.description:
Chunk the stored nodes of one converted representation with one profile and store the chunk set.
Use after knowledge_document_convert; knowledge_chunk_preview tries a profile on nodes you supply and stores nothing.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status, then propose the chunk set with knowledge_promotion_propose.

202.description: Chunk the stored nodes of one converted representation with one profile and store the chunk set.

post.summary: Attach converted documents to a vector store so they can be prepared for it.
post.description:
Attach converted documents to a vector store so they can be prepared for it.
Use after knowledge_store_create and knowledge_document_convert; it embeds and publishes nothing.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_store_status with the same vectorStoreId and this operationId.

202.description: Attach converted documents to a vector store so they can be prepared for it.

post.summary: Check that each attached document of a store has a complete chain from conversion to publication.
post.description:
Check that each attached document of a store has a complete chain from conversion to publication.
Use after the chain's operations finished; it converts, embeds and publishes nothing itself. It has no MCP tool or ks command.
Returns the accepted operation; read it with knowledge_store_status. Each of its three steps confirms one stage of every chain.

202.description: Check that each attached document of a store has a complete chain from conversion to publication.

post.summary: Rank and deduplicate candidate source URLs you already collected; it does not search the web.
post.description:
Rank and deduplicate candidate source URLs you already collected; it does not search the web.
Use first, to choose what to capture; use knowledge_source_resolve when you need canonical identifiers.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status, then fetch a candidate with knowledge_source_fetch.

202.description: Rank and deduplicate candidate source URLs you already collected; it does not search the web.

post.summary: Turn URLs, DOIs, arXiv ids and OpenReview ids into canonical identifiers and stable source ids.
post.description:
Turn URLs, DOIs, arXiv ids and OpenReview ids into canonical identifiers and stable source ids.
Use when two candidates may be the same source; it fetches nothing, unlike knowledge_source_fetch.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Its output has one canonical identifier per candidate.

202.description: Turn URLs, DOIs, arXiv ids and OpenReview ids into canonical identifiers and stable source ids.

post.summary: Measure how well approximate search in one vector-space version matches exact search for a query vector.
post.description:
Measure how well approximate search in one vector-space version matches exact search for a query vector.
Use to test an index before it is published; knowledge_eval_run scores retrieval answers against judged cases instead.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Its output has recallAtK and passed.

202.description: Measure how well approximate search in one vector-space version matches exact search for a query vector.

post.summary: Check a bundle of selected documents and claims and open a review of the result for a human reviewer.
post.description:
Check a bundle of selected documents and claims and open a review of the result for a human reviewer.
Use on an embedding bundle before preparing it; it checks URLs, text, entity anchors and target spaces, not truth.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Its output has per-document findings and a reviewSubjectId.

202.description: Check a bundle of selected documents and claims and open a review of the result for a human reviewer.

post.summary: Compare two versions of a document's nodes and report which were added, removed or changed.
post.description:
Compare two versions of a document's nodes and report which were added, removed or changed.
Use to judge a re-conversion against the earlier one; you supply both node lists, nothing is read from storage.
Returns the accepted operation; poll knowledge_promotion_status. Its output says whether the two sides are identical and lists the differences.

202.description: Compare two versions of a document's nodes and report which were added, removed or changed.

post.summary: Record a reviewer's decision on one converted document representation.
post.description:
Record a reviewer's decision on one converted document representation.
Use as the human review step after a conversion; agents cannot record it and it has no MCP tool.
Returns the accepted operation. Its output has the decisionId that a promotion proposal names as representationDecisionId.

202.description: Record a reviewer's decision on one converted document representation.

post.summary: Measure how well approximate search in a vector-space version matches exact search for a query vector.
post.description:
Measure how well approximate search in a vector-space version matches exact search for a query vector.
Use on a published version; it is the same check as a plain vector store evaluation and has no MCP tool.
Returns the accepted operation. Its output has recallAtK and passed.

202.description: Measure how well approximate search in a vector-space version matches exact search for a query vector.

post.summary: Switch a vector space back from its current publication to an earlier one.
post.description:
Switch a vector space back from its current publication to an earlier one.
Use as the operator step to undo a publication; agents cannot roll back and it has no MCP tool.
Returns the accepted operation. Its output has the switch receipt and, when queries were given, the baseline comparison.

202.description: Switch a vector space back from its current publication to an earlier one.

get.summary: Read one vector store: its class, owner, lifecycle, policies, document count and spaces.
get.description:
Read one vector store: its class, owner, lifecycle, policies, document count and spaces.
Use to inspect a store after it was created; it has no MCP tool.
Returns the vector store with at most 100 spaces; spacesTruncated says whether more exist.

200.description: Read one vector store: its class, owner, lifecycle, policies, document count and spaces.

get.summary: Read one stored evidence packet: its members with source locators and scores, coverage and abstention advice.
get.description:
Read one stored evidence packet: its members with source locators and scores, coverage and abstention advice.
Use to get the evidence of a retrieval run; knowledge_retrieve_citations re-reads the cited source text.
Returns the evidence packet. Check abstention.recommended before using the members; replay citations with knowledge_retrieve_citations.

200.description: Read one stored evidence packet: its members with source locators and scores, coverage and abstention advice.

get.summary: Fetch the stored source bytes behind each citation of an evidence packet and return the selected text again.
get.description:
Fetch the stored source bytes behind each citation of an evidence packet and return the selected text again.
Use to confirm that a packet's citations still resolve; knowledge_retrieve_packet returns the packet without re-reading sources.
Returns at most 128 replayed citations with their text and digests, and the citations that failed with a code each.

200.description: Fetch the stored source bytes behind each citation of an evidence packet and return the selected text again.

get.summary: Read one stored retrieval run: its plan record, stage timings, fusion settings and evidence packet ids.
get.description:
Read one stored retrieval run: its plan record, stage timings, fusion settings and evidence packet ids.
Use after knowledge_retrieve_search to find the packet; knowledge_retrieve_explain shows why each candidate ranked.
Returns the run with evidencePacketIds; read a packet with knowledge_retrieve_packet.

200.description: Read one stored retrieval run: its plan record, stage timings, fusion settings and evidence packet ids.

get.summary: Read why a retrieval run ranked its candidates: stage scores, final score, rank and the channels that found each one.
get.description:
Read why a retrieval run ranked its candidates: stage scores, final score, rank and the channels that found each one.
Use to debug a ranking; knowledge_retrieve_packet returns the evidence itself.
Returns at most 100 candidates with their sources per channel; truncated says whether more exist.

200.description: Read why a retrieval run ranked its candidates: stage scores, final score, rank and the channels that found each one.

get.summary: Read an immutable tenant-scoped resource

200.description: Read an immutable tenant-scoped resource

get.summary: Read the failing cases of one stored evaluation run, with their metrics and recorded output.
get.description:
Read the failing cases of one stored evaluation run, with their metrics and recorded output.
Use to see which cases failed and why; knowledge_eval_run scores a dataset and knowledge_eval_compare compares arms.
Returns at most 100 cases that did not pass or were falsely accepted or rejected; truncated says whether more exist.

200.description: Read the failing cases of one stored evaluation run, with their metrics and recorded output.

get.summary: Read an immutable tenant-scoped resource

200.description: Read an immutable tenant-scoped resource

get.summary: Read an immutable tenant-scoped resource

200.description: Read an immutable tenant-scoped resource

get.summary: Read the state of one operation that belongs to a vector store.
get.description:
Read the state of one operation that belongs to a vector store.
Use for store operations such as attaching documents or an ingestion check; knowledge_promotion_status reads any operation by id alone.
Returns the operation status: kind, state, receiptIds and, after a failure, a failure summary.

200.description: Read the state of one operation that belongs to a vector store.

get.summary: List the chunking profiles the service advertises, with their versions.
get.description:
List the chunking profiles the service advertises, with their versions.
Use before knowledge_chunk_preview, knowledge_chunk_compare or knowledge_chunk_build to pick profileName and profileVersion.
Returns { items: [{ id, version, admitted }], nextCursor: null }; pass id as profileName and version as profileVersion.

200.description: List the chunking profiles the service advertises, with their versions.

DescribeReference.name: ref
DescribeReference.description: tool:<MCP tool name>, operation:<operation kind or read name> or skill:<skill name>

ServiceUnavailable.description: Required durable dependency or capability unavailable
